---
title: "ggp-client"
subtitle: "Download, label and consolidate data from the GGP data portal"
toc: false
---

**ggp-client** is a Python package and command line tool for the
[GGP data portal](https://www.ggp-i.org) of the Generations and Gender Programme. It turns the portal's
country-by-country downloads into analysis-ready data:

1. **Index** every dataset on the portal into a local catalogue: GGS rounds 1 and 2, the Family and Fertility
   Surveys (FFS), the Harmonized Histories and the Additional Datasets (the last two are only visible after login).
2. **Download** the files you select, by project, round, wave and country, and unpack zip and 7z archives.
3. **Preprocess** each data file (`.dta`, `.sav`, `.csv`, or FFS fixed-width `.dat` with its SPSS syntax) to
   parquet, with its variable and value labels in a `meta.json` file.
4. **Consolidate** the countries of each round and wave into one dataset, with one harmonized set of labels,
   as parquet and as a labelled Stata file.

```bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/jossl95/ggp_client"
ggp-client sync
ggp-client download    --project ggs --round 2 --ext dta
ggp-client preprocess  --project ggs --round 2
ggp-client consolidate --project ggs --round 2   # data/download/consolidated/ggs-ii_w1.parquet, ...
```

## Why

The portal ships every country as a separate archive, in several formats and with labels that differ between
countries. Working with all countries of a wave means downloading dozens of files by hand, reading Stata or SPSS
files, and stacking them while keeping track of which labels apply. ggp-client does that once, reproducibly, and
keeps everything it did in a log.

## Built with

[httpx](https://www.python-httpx.org) for the asynchronous downloads,
[polars](https://pola.rs) for reading, preprocessing and consolidating (lazy and multi-threaded),
[pyreadstat](https://github.com/Roche/pyreadstat) for Stata and SPSS files and their labels, and
[py7zr](https://github.com/miurahr/py7zr) for 7z archives.
